definitions.explanation: Liable to break or be damaged, either physically or figuratively.

examples.japanese: ⟦ガラス→ガラス：01777_garasu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{壊|こわ}れやすい。
{壊|こわ}れやすい⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{丁寧|ていねい}→丁寧：00896_teinei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{運|はこ}んで→運ぶ：01088_hakobu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。

⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{機械|きかい}→機械：02366_kikai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{精密|せいみつ}→精密：13775_seimitsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{壊|こわ}れやすい⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{衝撃|しょうげき}→衝撃：08678_shougeki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{与|あた}えない→与える：01821_ataeru⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{気|き}をつけて⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: This machine is delicate and easily broken, so please be careful not to subject it to shocks.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{壊|こわ}れる→壊れる：00791_kowareru⟧ (to break) + やすい (easy to). This is a productive grammatical pattern in Japanese where verb stem + やすい means "easy to do" or "prone to."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {壊|こわ}れやすい⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧: fragile item
- {壊|こわ}れやすい⟦{素材|そざい}→素材：09492_sozai⟧: fragile material
- {壊|こわ}れやすい⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧: fragile relationship

USAGE:
Often seen on packaging and shipping labels. The formal equivalent for labeling is {取扱注意|とりあつかいちゅうい} (handle with care) or ワレモノ⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧ (fragile — caution).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- もろい: brittle, fragile — emphasizes structural weakness
- デリケートな: delicate — loanword, often for sensitive topics or skin
- ⟦{脆弱|ぜいじゃく}→脆弱：07523_zeijaku⟧な: vulnerable, fragile — formal, often used for systems or security

forms.label: Conditional たら
forms.negative: {壊|こわ}れやすくなかったら
